whatsapp.intro: Link your personal WhatsApp by scanning a QR code, like WhatsApp Web.
whatsapp.notConnected: Not linked. Your saved chats stay here.
whatsapp.unavailable: WhatsApp linking is not set up on this server.
whatsapp.privacy: The session runs on our WhatsApp server in its own instance with its own key. Your messages are stored for your account only.
whatsapp.linked: Linked {phone}. Your recent chats are on their way.
whatsapp.qr2: Go to Settings, Linked devices, Link a device.
whatsapp.qr3: Point your phone at this code.
whatsapp.removeBody: This unlinks the device and deletes every WhatsApp chat, message and scheduled send saved in Inbox. Nothing is deleted on your phone.
whatsapp.unlinkBody: Inbox stops receiving and sending messages. Your saved chats stay here and come back to life when you link again.
whatsapp.resyncBody: WhatsApp only sends chat history when a device is linked. To bring it in, Inbox ends the current session and shows a new QR code: scan it from WhatsApp › Linked devices. Chats already here stay. History can take a few minutes to show up.

gmail.intro: Connect Gmail with Google. Done archives in Gmail too, and read state stays in sync.
gmail.unavailable: Gmail is not set up on this server.
gmail.removeBody: Inbox disconnects from Google and deletes the threads it saved. Your mail stays in Gmail.

snippets.variables: '{name}' and '{first_name}' are replaced with the chat name.
snippets.deleteBody: The snippet is deleted. Messages you already sent do not change.

import.title: Import old conversations
import.help: Bring what your local inbox-zero app has today: folders and which chats are in each, pending scheduled messages, drafts, snoozes, notes and memories, and saved message history. Gmail app passwords are never exported.
import.step1: On the computer where inbox-zero runs, open a terminal in this repository.
import.step3: Pick the generated file here and import it. A large file uploads directly and keeps importing even if you close this screen. Importing twice never duplicates anything.
import.summary: {folders} folders, {chats} chats, {scheduled} scheduled, {drafts} drafts, {snoozes} snoozes, {notes} notes, {messages} messages.
import.result: Imported {folders} folders, {chats} chats, {scheduled} scheduled, {drafts} drafts, {snoozes} snoozes, {notes} notes and {messages} messages.
import.partial: The import stopped after part {done} of {total}. Import again to finish: nothing is duplicated.
import.waHelp: Brings every chat and all its messages that the WhatsApp server stored when you linked your number, one page at a time. It keeps going in the background and you can pause it.
import.step2Help: With --desktop it adds the full WhatsApp Desktop history from that Mac. With --days 90 it brings only the last 90 days.
import.resumeHint: {pct}% of this file is already imported: it continues from there.
import.partialBytes: The import stopped at {pct}%. Pick the same file and import again: it continues from there and never duplicates.
import.jobsError: The imports could not be loaded.
import.jobsEmpty: You have not imported anything yet.
import.whySyncing: Waiting for WhatsApp to finish sending the history from linking. It starts on its own.
import.whyNotConnected: WhatsApp is not connected. It continues when you link it again.
